## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Kilocode agent usage aggregation MEDIUM ~6-8h (core, sessionManager, costTracker, telemetry)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #15185 (merged 2026-10-17) adds project-scoped agent usage aggregation. Commit title: "feat(cli): add project-scoped agent usage aggregation". Feature: new AgentUsage module derives per-agent usage (cost, active time, tokens, outcomes) from persisted session/message/part rows without downloading full transcripts. Runs = assistant messages sharing a user-message parentID and agent id. Direct cost and tokens come from step-finish parts only (assistant message cost field carries propagated subagent cost and would double-count a child run). Active time sums per-message execution time (idle time between turns is never counted). Module is project-scoped, returns runs newest-first by (startedAt, id). Query drives session, message, and step-finish indexes (EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN test verifies no table scans). Commit #15180 hardens run outcome precedence (test error before completion time so error+no-time is errored not running) and adds index coverage regression test.

- **Why**: Alexi has session persistence (src/core/sessionManager.ts, JSON file per session in ~/.alexi/sessions/) and in-memory cost tracking (src/core/costTracker.ts, per-session prompt/completion tokens + cost). Kilocode pattern: derive per-agent aggregates (total cost, active time, outcomes) from structured session data without loading full transcript, enabling agent-level ROI analysis and cost attribution. Alexi equivalent: audit if current JSON schema captures enough structure to compute per-agent aggregates. Required fields: agentId per message (check SessionManager.addMessage metadata), step-finish parts with direct cost (check if messages carry usage breakdown), parentID for run grouping (check if user/assistant linkage exists), timestamps for active-time calculation (check message timestamps). If schema is sufficient, add AgentUsage query module (read session JSONs, group by agentId, sum cost/tokens/time, classify outcomes). If fields missing, propose schema extension (add agentId to message metadata, add usage per-message, add parent linkage). MEDIUM ~6-8h: audit SessionManager JSON structure (read sample session file, check fields), prototype aggregation query (group by agent, sum cost), test with multi-agent sessions, document query or propose schema changes.

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15185 (agent usage aggregation), https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/fix-agent-usage-outcome-precedence (outcome precedence + index test), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/sessionManager.ts (Alexi session persistence), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/costTracker.ts (Alexi cost tracking)

- **Category**: core (sessionManager, costTracker, telemetry, agent usage aggregation)

- **Size**: MEDIUM ~6-8h (audit SessionManager JSON schema for agentId + usage + parentID + timestamps, add per-agent aggregation query if schema sufficient or propose schema extension if fields missing, test with multi-agent sessions)

#### 2. Langfuse error span correlation for stream failures CARRY-FORWARD MEDIUM ~6-8h (providers, telemetry, error handling, issue #2057)

- **What**: Carry-forward from 2026-10-16 research #3 (Cline PR #15100 stream retry + Langfuse error reporting). Issue #2057 opened by 2026-10-16 research. Cline pattern: three-retry stream error handling with terminal error classification + Langfuse span correlation (failed attempts close Langfuse spans with error status + context fields: errorType, errorMessage, isTerminal). Alexi has ErrorBackoff (src/core/error-backoff.ts) with 5 retries, streamingOrchestrator.ts with watchdog + empty-response retry, Langfuse telemetry (src/providers/langfuse-telemetry.ts) with startLangfuseGeneration / finishLangfuseGeneration / failLangfuseGeneration. Audit 2026-10-17: streamingOrchestrator.ts L551-639 catches provider stream errors, attempts context-overflow recovery (tryOverflowRecovery) and max-tokens recovery (tryMaxTokensRecovery), then classifies route error (classifyRouteError) and formats provider error (formatProviderError) before rethrowing. **Missing**: explicit failLangfuseGeneration call in the catch block. Current code path: startLangfuseGeneration called somewhere (not visible in snippet), stream error thrown from watchdog, catch block in streamingOrchestrator formats error and rethrows, but no Langfuse span close with error status. Langfuse span may be left open or closed as success when stream fails.

- **Why**: Observability gap. Stream failures (network blips mid-response, idle timeout, provider 5xx mid-stream) may not close Langfuse spans with error status, making it hard to diagnose failure patterns in Langfuse dashboard. Cline pattern: classify stream errors (transient vs terminal), close Langfuse generation span with error status + context (errorType, errorMessage, isTerminal) before rethrowing. Alexi equivalent: (1) audit where startLangfuseGeneration is called (sapOrchestration.ts or streamingOrchestrator.ts), (2) verify if stream errors already call failLangfuseGeneration (search for failLangfuseGeneration calls in error paths), (3) if missing, add failLangfuseGeneration(generation, err) to streamingOrchestrator.ts catch block (L551-639) before formatting and rethrowing, (4) classify transient vs terminal errors (use ErrorBackoff.isFatal or classifyProviderError), (5) attach error context (errorType = classifyProviderError result, isTerminal = ErrorBackoff.isFatal, errorMessage = err.message), (6) test: simulate network blip mid-stream (kill provider connection), verify Langfuse span closes with ERROR level and context fields. MEDIUM ~6-8h HIGH priority for observability.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15100 (stream retry + Langfuse error spans), https://github.com/YOUR_ORG/alexi/issues/2057 (opened by 2026-10-16 research), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts L551-639 (stream error catch block, no failLangfuseGeneration call visible), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/langfuse-telemetry.ts L465-482 (failLangfuseGeneration helper), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/error-backoff.ts (error classification)

- **Category**: providers (stream retry, langfuse telemetry, error spans)

- **Size**: MEDIUM ~6-8h (audit startLangfuseGeneration call sites, verify if stream errors already call failLangfuseGeneration, add error span close to streamingOrchestrator catch block if missing, classify transient vs terminal, attach error context, test network-blip retry + Langfuse capture). HIGH priority for observability (issue #2057 already opened).

#### 3. Kilocode late OpenRouter reasoning details REFERENCE-ONLY (providers, reasoning, openrouter)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #15180 (merged 2026-10-17) persists late OpenRouter reasoning details for replay. Commit title: "fix(cli): persist late OpenRouter reasoning details for replay". Issue: OpenRouter sends reasoning usage details (reasoning_tokens, etc.) in a separate event AFTER the step-finish part (which carries cost + usage). Session replay would miss these late details because step-finish already closed. Fix: reconcile late reasoning details with the stored step-finish part metadata when they arrive after the fact (keep stored tool metadata, merge reasoning fields). Test: reasoning replay test types fixed, stored tool metadata preserved during reconciliation.

- **Why**: Alexi uses SAP AI Core Orchestration provider exclusively (src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts), not OpenRouter. SAP Orchestration does not exhibit the late-reasoning-detail pattern (reasoning usage arrives with the stream finish, not as a separate follow-up event). REFERENCE-ONLY: if Alexi adds OpenRouter as a provider in the future, reference this pattern for reasoning detail reconciliation (merge late reasoning fields with stored step-finish metadata without clobbering tool metadata). Current priority SKIP - no OpenRouter provider.

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15180 (late OpenRouter reasoning details), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts (Alexi provider, no OpenRouter)

- **Category**: N/A (providers, reasoning, openrouter, reference-only)

- **Size**: SKIP. Alexi uses SAP Orchestration, not OpenRouter. Reference for future OpenRouter provider support.
